body:
Founder real-time: "then i need a new blog post you choose the guest and the topic dont make it
about how its confusing to work with an adhd founder shooting tons oif shit in and how discipline
is important every blog post is about that make this one unique."

Deliberately picked a different register and domain from every other post this session: TINA
(FatBaby Markets Desk), an existing compliance-forward persona (read 3 prior TINA posts for exact
voice/format before writing), covering two REAL, dated, sourced capital-return events that crossed
the pipeline today -- MDU Resources' dividend raise ($0.145/share) and Globant's buyback
completion ($25M), both verified directly against var/dividends/dividends.ndjson and
var/buybacks/buybacks.ndjson (not summarized from a headline aggregator). Zero mention of
founder-input-chaos or process discipline -- topic is purely "what these two real filings actually
mean and don't mean," with TINA's own established boundary (real sourced facts only, no valuation
judgment) held throughout.

Published via IDUNA POST /api/v1/blog/posts:
https://okemily.com/blog/tina-dividend-raise-vs-buyback-completion/ (verified live, HTTP 200).
title: Published TINA blog post: dividend raise vs buyback completion (real, sourced)
